thread:
sam: Starting RC promotion for candidate v2024.03-rc2. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need final signoffs: QA, SRE, release lead. @dana you're on sheriff tonight, can you take handoff? Pinned artifact: sha:a1b2c3d4.

Dana: Ack — I'll take sheriff. Please confirm smoke test URL and canary dashboard.

jess: QA: smoke passed, regression had 1 flaky (test_search_index). OK to proceed if we gate the feature-flagged path. :+1:

mike: SRE: OK with promo, request health guard rails:
- auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.7% OR p95 > 250ms in a step
- pin target on rollback to sha:z9y8x7w6
Also want rollout id logged by deploy-bot.

sam: Plan: staged rollout 10% (15m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (5m). Health checks: error_rate, p95, queue_len. If any fail, immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled. Rollout id r-20240321-451.
Command:
`/deploy promote --id r-20240321-451 --to prod --strategy staged --steps 10,50,100 --health-checks error_rate,p95,queue_len --pin-on-fail z9y8x7w6`

deploy-bot: Step 1 -> 10% started. logs: allocating hosts, switching route. Monitor: https://ops.redwood/rollouts/r-20240321-451

Dana: Watching dashboard now. slight p95 blip but within threshold.

deploy-bot: Step 2 -> 50% complete. p95 up ~80ms, continuing.

jess: QA seeing a burst of 500s against embedding-service, tracing id f3e6. Investigating.

mike: Alert: error_rate crossed 0.8% over 5m window. Triggering rollback per policy.

sam: Acknowledged — approve rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Pinning to sha:z9y8x7w6 and reverting traffic.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Rollout r-20240321-451 reverted. Duration 28m. Details in logs: https://ops.redwood/logs/r-20240321-451

Dana: Thanks all. Please file a postdeploy note and tag QA to re-run the flaky search_index test.

sam: Filing release note: attempted promo of v2024.03-rc2; rolled back due to embedding-service error spike. Candidate remains for rework. Next: triage, fix, try a narrower canary once embedding-service fix lands.
